name: action-refusal
title: Action refusal
description: ActionRefusedError, unavailable() and settled(): a component action called by an agent or app code throws with why it did not run (refused by the app through details.cancel(), or not available in the current state), so UI SDK's agent bridge fails the step instead of reporting ok. A person's press that can't apply still returns false. The message ends with a [refused:action] or [unavailable:action] tag, since UI SDK's act result keeps only the message of a failed step, and parseActionRefusal(result.error) reads it back as { action, kind, text }, or null for any other failure.
